name: BNL-E-0776
summary: BNL E776 searched for electron-flavour appearance in neutrino and antineutrino beams at a kilometre baseline, setting important pre-LSND short-baseline oscillation constraints.
detection_principle: A finely segmented electromagnetic calorimeter identified electron showers, followed by a muon spectrometer to characterize the dominant muon-neutrino sample. Predicted intrinsic electron-flavour backgrounds were compared with measured candidates in both horn polarities.

status.label: Completed / historical

key_parameters.name: Calorimeter
key_parameters.value: Approximately 230-ton segmented electromagnetic calorimeter with downstream toroidal muon spectrometer

key_parameters.name: Published exposure
key_parameters.value: 3 x 10^19 protons on target divided between neutrino and antineutrino polarities

results.summary: No excess electron-neutrino or electron-antineutrino population was detected above expected backgrounds; two-flavour limits were reported.

science_scope: The record describes the named experiment as one programme; detector subsystems and repeated analyses are not counted as independent experiments.
